title: How fast is fast?

captions.instagram:
"50% faster": a target or a result?

For BUILT®, it's a target. Per JemRock research, our design target is more than 50% faster timelines. McKinsey (2019) found modular construction can be 20-50% faster. Those are different kinds of numbers, and I want to be clear about which is which.

Save the 4 questions for any speed claim.

What would convince you a speed claim is real?
captions.linkedin:
A design target is not a result, and I think founders should say so out loud.

Per JemRock research, our design target for BUILT® is more than 50% faster timelines. Independent research is a different kind of number: McKinsey (2019) found modular construction can be 20-50% faster and save up to 20% on cost.

Even a faster factory meets the same real world: approvals and permits, financing, and delivery to site.

Four questions for any speed claim: Who measured it? Compared with what? On which project? Including approvals?
